name: After § 65
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 65a. Deplores the fact that, although Syria under the al-Sharaa government receives funding from the EU, the protection of Christian communities and other minorities in Syria, which are victims of violence perpetrated by Islamist militias supported by the authorities in Damascus, is not guaranteed; calls on the EU to strictly ensure that EU funds do not under any circumstances contribute, directly or indirectly, to the arming of terrorist groups targeting Christian communities or other parts of Syrian society, which have been victims of Islamist terrorism for decades;
